sources.title: e-Visa Tchad: legal notice
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal says Foreign Affairs hosts it and Immigration prepares its content, but no independent current central Chadian government page linking to evisa.td was retrieved.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le suivi éditorial, graphique et technique est assuré par le Ministère des Affaires Étrangères.

sources.title: e-Visa Tchad: current eligibility and electronic-issuance claims
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal is current and cites the 2025 entry decree and 2026 tariff order, but its government affiliation was not independently authenticated by a Chad government domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ce site permet à tout étranger non exempté de visa ... de soumettre sa demande d’e-Visa en ligne.

sources.title: Chad Ministry of Foreign Affairs website
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: The direct ministry domain presently serves only its maintenance notice and supplies no visa-service link or authentication chain for evisa.td.
